ideas.title: FBI Investigations into Cybercrime and Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the various FBI investigations into cybercrime and fraud, including the breach of its surveillance network and suspicious cyber activity on a system holding sensitive surveillance information.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to follow the money and determine the extent of the fraud and cybercrime.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud and cybercrime?
Who are the individuals and entities involved?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves the FBI and national security, and could have significant implications for the country.

ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the role of CMS and the state government.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to determine the extent of the fraud and who is responsible.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves the misuse of taxpayer dollars and the potential harm to vulnerable populations.
